Use case: stylized-concept. Produce exactly TWO separately drawn Walking Dead creature sprites in one row, two columns, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background.

Treat the original source silhouettes as a precise joint-position blueprint; match shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle locations, lean, figure width/height ratio and limb overlaps. Chest and both shoulders face almost front, head nearly front with only a small remaining rightward turn. The injured skeletal hand is low at the viewer's left. Copy the guide exactly; do not use a fully right-facing idle or let the cleaver project far to the right.
RIGHT: fully frontal torso, fully frontal face looking at the viewer, both knees bent as in the guide. The cleaver-holding forearm crosses in front of the lower chest/abdomen. The cleaver is turned EDGE-ON to the viewer: a very thin nearly vertical metal edge rises centrally in front of the torso toward the chin. Do NOT show a broad flat blade beside the shoulder. The other skeletal hand remains on the viewer's left, and the injured shin stays on the same original side. The source guide controls the exact overlaps.
